behavior: Tests guard what matters: a written rule keeps money, security, data-integrity and real-regression tests, and low-value unit tests are removed
acceptance: docs/workflow.md (or the owning test rules) says which tests to write and keep: money and ledger rules, auth and security, data integrity, API contracts, parsing at trust boundaries, and regressions of bugs a user hit; not tests that only restate copy text, constants, simple rendering or a one-off fix already covered by e2e

Unit test files and cases that fall outside the rule are removed; the removal list with a one-line reason each is in the PR; every remaining check passes and the unit check runs faster (time before and after)
notes: 2026-10-15 review fail by independent reviewer: FAIL on cef292a. Only tests and docs changed; lint, typecheck (--force), web 70, ui 14, tokens 52 tests pass. Two removals drop money protection that the new rule says to keep, with no other unit or e2e coverage: (1) apps/web/src/features/activity/tests/activity-amounts.test.tsx 'Activity names held money' (F196 fix: a held deposit must not read as Payment in Activity; 'Held for the payer' appears in no e2e for Activity) and the exact-amount cases (F174 audit bug: Activity row 1.005 and toast 0.0015 USDC, not 0.00; components must pass exactDigits; no e2e uses such amounts). Restore the file. (2) apps/web/src/features/pay/tests/pay.test.ts 'payToken > names OUSD on Tempo and refuses a token this build does not know': the public pay page must refuse a chain+contract it does not know (unknownToken, no address); nothing else tests it. Other findings: onboarding.test.ts keeps dead _nothing, _done and a type-only checklistSteps import, and receive-choice.test.ts keeps dead _OPTIONS; the underscore only silences lint, delete them. workflow.md last sentence says to select contracts 'beyond unit', but the contracts check runs the same forge fmt --check && forge test as unit; drop contracts from that list. Optional, low risk: profiles-api.test.ts (Bearer header; only the local-only Privy e2e covers it, fail-closed 401), invoices.test.ts recheck case 'Found 4000000 units' (onChain minus recorded; e2e only tests recorded=0). Rest of the removals fit the rule: customExpiresIn and 422 field mapping are UX (backend enforces 900..31536000 and validates), apiSearch cap is UX (API answers 422), rate-limit helpers are covered through withRateLimit, iso-date toTime validation, afterOnboarding redirect, CSV, chains and token-amount stay.
